title: N3onDefense is growing!
author: Thin_Alternative2372
selftext:
🚨 **BIG N3ONDefense UPDATE** 🚨

N3ONDefense just took another huge step forward. 😎⚡

🎮 **FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT IS HERE**  
You can now play the entire game with a controller — menus, combat, upgrades, Mods, everything. It feels way more like a complete game now and opens the door for where I want to take N3ONDefense next.

🕹️ **N3ON ARCADE EVENTS**  
The arena is no longer just about surviving the round. Random Arcade Events can now kick off during gameplay, giving you extra objectives, bonus rewards, and another reason to keep watching everything happening around you while the arena is already going crazy.

🔥 **SUPREME OVERDRIVE**  
For the players who thought regular Overdrive wasn't enough... we went further.

Supreme Overdrive adds:

* New progression levels
* An entirely new set of powerful Mod cards
* More build possibilities
* More reasons to keep pushing deeper into the game
* Even more absolute neon chaos when everything starts stacking together

🃏 **MOD LIBRARY REWORK**  
The Mod Library also got a major overhaul. Instead of simply showing what cards you've collected, you can now dig into detailed information about each Mod — what it does, its stats, effects, rank information, rarity, and how it can impact your build.

The Mod system has grown into one of my favorite parts of the entire game, so I wanted the library to finally feel like a real place to study your collection and plan builds instead of just being a card gallery.

N3ONDefense keeps getting bigger, deeper, louder, and significantly more ridiculous. 😂

And we're still not done.

**RuntWerkx Gaming Division Presents — N3ONDefense** ⚡💀🎮
